headline: THE E6 APEX FAMILY: the twistor cones of S^4/(2T x Gamma_R) are G2 cones whose first pole carries E6 and whose second pole carries the companion {+-1}.Gamma_R, always of even order and never A2, with mixed A-loci over the cone circles whenever Gamma_R shares an eigenvalue with 2T; only Gamma_R=1 has a companion (A1) that the object's own background supplies.

headline: THE K3 ALTERNATIVE, DECIDED: the orbit types of a 2T action with isolated fixed points are determined by a Burnside count from the per-order fixed-point numbers; with Nikulin's K3 numbers the count has exactly two solutions (Xiao's #37, #38 for T24), neither with an A1 orbit, so no K3-fibred background can supply the SU(2) companion B1358 needs -- the three-generation design lives on the Hurwitz torus only.
